Chapter 17
Diseases of the Endocrine System  507
Etiology Reactive hypoglycemia may occur in individu-
als with diabetes due to administration of too much insulin or 
oral diabetes medications. In those without diabetes, reactive
hypoglycemia may occur due to a sharp increase in insulin 
release after a meal. It usually disappears when the individual
eats something.60
